assumptions.statement: The overall boundary and all three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional constraints.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.release_condition: Official georeferenced SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA files pass provenance and CRS review.

assumptions.statement: No site walk, resident interview, facility inventory, opening-hour survey, or accessibility audit was available to this Agent.
assumptions.impact: The proposal defines an audit-and-prototype network; it does not claim that any listed service is currently missing or sufficient.
assumptions.release_condition: Documented multi-time field survey and affected-user co-audit are completed.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, existing buildings, heritage limits, utilities, fire safety, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building, transport, facility, and phasing layers are conceptual interfaces only; statutory and engineering conclusions remain unknown.
assumptions.release_condition: Relevant official attachments and professional surveys are obtained and reviewed.

assumptions.statement: No operator, budget, staffing plan, service-level commitment, or implementation approval has been confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Operating cards and annual events are reference mechanisms, not government or investor commitments.
assumptions.release_condition: Named operators, responsibilities, resources, rights safeguards, and stop conditions are approved through proper processes.
